SELECT
    channel_name,
    sku_id,
    SUM(gross_sales_amount) AS total_gross_sales,
    SUM(return_cost) AS total_return_costs,
    SUM(marketplace_fees_commissions) AS total_marketplace_fees,
    SUM(logistics_cost_per_sku) AS total_logistics_costs,

        SUM(item_value) AS gross_sales_amount, -- Inferred item-level value
        0.0 AS return_cost,
        0.0 AS marketplace_fees_commissions,
        0.0 AS logistics_cost_per_sku
    FROM
        zs_observe.increff_sales
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true
        AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_type = 'SALES' -- Per increff constraints
    GROUP BY 1, 2

    UNION ALL

    -- JioMart OMS Sales (with SKU-level performance hint)\
    SELECT
        'JioMart' AS channel_name,
        sku_id,
        SUM(item_gmv) AS gross_sales_amount, -- Inferred item-level GMV from JioMart OMS
        0.0 AS return_cost,
        COALESCE(SUM(seller_coupon_discount_impact_amount), 0.0) AS marketplace_fees_commissions, -- An example of a deduction type cost
        0.0 AS logistics_cost_per_sku
    FROM
        zs_observe.jiomart_oms
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true
    GROUP BY 1, 2

    UNION ALL

    -- Myntra OMS Sales (total_amount at order level, need to infer item_level attribution)\
    SELECT
        'Myntra' AS channel_name,
        oms.sku_id, -- Assuming sku_id is available in myntra_oms or joinable
        SUM(TRY_CAST(oms.total_amount AS DOUBLE)) AS gross_sales_amount, -- Myntra gross sales pattern uses total_amount
        0.0 AS return_cost,
        0.0 AS marketplace_fees_commissions,
        0.0 AS logistics_cost_per_sku
    FROM
        zs_observe.myntra_oms oms
    WHERE
        oms.group_level_id = '22'
        -- rule.myntra.oms_no_is_active implies no is_active filter here
    GROUP BY 1, 2

    UNION ALL

    -- Amazon OMS Sales (inferred item-level sales)\
    SELECT
        'Amazon' AS channel_name,
        sku_id, -- Inferred sku_id column
        SUM(item_amount) AS gross_sales_amount, -- Inferred item-level sales amount
        0.0 AS return_cost,
        0.0 AS marketplace_fees_commissions,
        0.0 AS logistics_cost_per_sku
    FROM
        zs_observe.amazon_oms
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter
    GROUP BY 1, 2

    UNION ALL

    -- Shopify OMS Sales (D2C - inferred item-level sales)\
    SELECT
        'Shopify D2C' AS channel_name,
        sku_id, -- Inferred sku_id column
        SUM(item_amount) AS gross_sales_amount, -- Inferred item-level sales amount
        0.0 AS return_cost,
        0.0 AS marketplace_fees_commissions,
        0.0 AS logistics_cost_per_sku
    FROM
        zs_observe.shopify_oms
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter
    GROUP BY 1, 2

    UNION ALL

    -- Meesho Returns Costs (explicitly available at SKU level in return patterns)\
    SELECT
        'Meesho' AS channel_name,
        r.sku_id,
        0.0 AS gross_sales_amount, -- Not a sales record
        SUM(r.total_cost_of_returns) AS return_cost, -- Explicit metric
        0.0 AS marketplace_fees_commissions,
        COALESCE(SUM(rev.monthly_reverse_shipping_cost), 0.0) AS logistics_cost_per_sku -- Allocated from reverse, needs explicit SKU join or allocation
    FROM
        zs_observe.meesho_returns r
        LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_reverse rev ON r.order_id = rev.order_id AND r.sku_id = rev.sku_id AND r.group_level_id = rev.group_level_id -- Assuming SKU join for reverse costs
    WHERE
        r.group_level_id = '22'
        AND r.is_active = true -- Inferred filter
    GROUP BY 1, 2

    UNION ALL

    -- JioMart Returns Costs (explicitly available at SKU level)\
    SELECT
        'JioMart' AS channel_name,
        sku_id,
        0.0 AS gross_sales_amount,
        SUM(return_amount) AS return_cost, -- Inferred return_amount per SKU
        0.0 AS marketplace_fees_commissions,
        0.0 AS logistics_cost_per_sku
    FROM
        zs_observe.jiomart_returns
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter
    GROUP BY 1, 2

    UNION ALL

    -- Amazon Returns Costs (explicitly bound, assumed SKU-level)\
    SELECT
        'Amazon' AS channel_name,
        sku_id,
        0.0 AS gross_sales_amount,
        SUM(return_cost) AS return_cost, -- Inferred return_cost per SKU
        0.0 AS marketplace_fees_commissions,
        0.0 AS logistics_cost_per_sku
    FROM
        zs_observe.amazon_returns
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter
    GROUP BY 1, 2

    -- Marketplace Fees (highly challenging to allocate to SKU without specific item-level fees, showing as 0.0 with caveat)\
    -- Myntra Settlement fees: prepaid_commission, postpaid_commission, prepaid_mp_fees, postpaid_mp_fees
    -- Meesho Settlement fees: meesho_commission_percentage (can apply to SKU sales proportionally, but needs join to sales first)
    -- JioMart Settlement fees: Deductions
    -- These require complex joins back to the SKU level and specific allocation logic not detailed in context.
    -- For now, they are either assumed 0.0 or covered by broader adjustments if not directly attributed.

)
SELECT
    channel_name,
    sku_id,
    SUM(gross_sales_amount) AS total_gross_sales,
    SUM(return_cost) AS total_return_costs,
    SUM(marketplace_fees_commissions) AS total_marketplace_fees,
    SUM(logistics_cost_per_sku) AS total_logistics_costs,
    SUM(gross_sales_amount) - SUM(return_cost) - SUM(marketplace_fees_commissions) - SUM(logistics_cost_per_sku) AS net_profit_per_sku
FROM
    BaseSKUSales
GROUP BY
    channel_name, sku_id
ORDER BY
    channel_name, net_profit_per_sku DESC;"}
